    DAMPING = 1.0  # Moderate damping to absorb impacts
    SAFE_Y = [3.6, 4.0, 4.8]  # Safe y positions outside forbidden bands

    # Anchor beam at x=7.0, y=0.5 (ground level)
    anchor = sandbox.add_beam(7.0, 0.5, 0.1, 0.1, 0, BEAM_DENSITY)
    sandbox.add_joint(anchor, None, (7.0, 0.5 + 0.05), type="rigid")
    sandbox.set_damping(anchor, linear=DAMPING, angular=DAMPING)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(anchor, restitution=0.0)

    # Vertical pillars at safe x positions
    pillars = []
    for x in [7.0, 7.76, 9.6]:
        pillar = sandbox.add_beam(x, GROUND_TOP, 0.1, 4.0, 0, BEAM_DENSITY)
        sandbox.add_joint(pillar, None, (x, GROUND_TOP), type="rigid")
        sandbox.add_joint(anchor, pillar, (x, GROUND_TOP), type="rigid")
        sandbox.set_damping(pillar, linear=DAMPING, angular=DAMPING)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(pillar, restitution=0.0)
        pillars.append(pillar)

    # Horizontal beams at safe y positions to catch projectiles
    for y in SAFE_Y:
        beam = sandbox.add_beam(7.0, y, 4.0, 0.1, 0, BEAM_DENSITY)

        for x in [7.0, 7.76, 9.6]:

        sandbox.set_damping(beam, linear=DAMPING, angular=DAMPING)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(beam, restitution=0.0)

    # Verify constraints
